purpose: Causal localization of a fixed delimiter-scaling failure, not a deployable method

factorial.purpose: Disambiguate source-image position bias from option-letter/order bias after delimiter scaling
factorial.selection: Eight hash-selected questions of four-image caption matching; selection independent of correctness and shift direction
measurements: Accuracy across 16 balanced permutations per question
Predicted option-letter distribution versus predicted image-position distribution
Within-question consistency when option order alone changes
Within-question equivariance when image order changes
Processed first-step scores conditional on single-token answer formats: bare A-D and parenthesized A-D when tokenizer supports all four.
factorial.interpretation: Exploratory post-hoc follow-up to P002. Not independent held-out confirmation or evidence of novelty.
falsifiers: If bias follows option letter rather than image index, reject the ordinal-boundary hypothesis
If shifts disappear under permutations/greedy decoding, do not claim systematic source-index corruption
factorial.format_caveat: These are generation-processed scores, including repetition penalty, not raw logits; only groups with one token per candidate are compared.

capture: Unmodified-model input_layernorm output immediately before every decoder attention; start/end vectors stored separately
patch: Restore normalized vectors only, retaining target token/RoPE positions; token kind and donor order fixed before observing results
donor_preprocessing: Independent calibration images resized to each target image native dimensions before same Qwen preprocessing; assert identical input IDs and image grid
negative_control: Donor vectors shifted by one image position within each token kind, with original target RoPE retained
integrity: Clean both must reproduce baseline generation and first-step scores; it is a mathematical implementation control, not scientific gain
decision: If same-position unrelated donor fails to rescue or performs like shifted donor, reject the simple structural-boundary template mechanism. Clean recovery alone is insufficient.
limitations: Eight previously examined Mantis questions, repeated permutations dependent
Same-position vs shifted donors confound abstract ordinal index with absolute token/RoPE-derived context; successful pilot still needs length/position controls
No tuning or claim on Muir heldout
